blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解微生物實驗室「乾淨區」與「活菌區」的分區設計原則及交叉汙染防控
blocks.en: Understand the design principles for separating the "clean area" from the "viable area" in a microbiology laboratory, and how to prevent cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 掌握 PCR/DNA/RNA 測試區域與傳統微生物區域的隔離要求（2022 新增）
blocks.en: Master the segregation requirements between PCR/DNA/RNA testing areas and traditional microbiology areas (new in 2022)

blocks.zh: 了解樣品處理的關鍵時間與溫度限制：取樣後盡快開始測試、不得冷凍保存微生物樣品
blocks.en: Understand the key time and temperature limits for sample handling: start testing as soon as possible after sampling, and never freeze microbiological samples

blocks.zh: 認識無菌試驗的環境控制要求：隔離器（Isolator）優於潔淨室
blocks.en: Understand the environmental control requirements for sterility testing: isolators are preferred over cleanrooms

blocks.zh: 學習培養溫度偏移（Temperature Excursion）的影響評估與處置原則
blocks.en: Learn the principles for assessing and handling incubation temperature excursions

blocks.zh: Laboratory Layout and Operations — 實驗室佈局與操作
blocks.en: Laboratory Layout and Operations

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 醫院感染管控的比喻：就像醫院把感染病房和普通病房分開一樣。微生物實驗室也需要這種「區域管控」。如果你剛在感染病房（活菌區）照顧過有傳染性的病人，不能穿著同一套衣服直接走進手術室（乾淨區）去做無菌手術。同樣的，實驗室人員從活菌區出來必須更換防護衣、洗手消毒後才能進入乾淨區。
blocks.en: A hospital infection-control analogy: Just as a hospital separates infectious-disease wards from general wards, a microbiology laboratory needs this kind of "zone control." If you have just cared for a contagious patient in the infectious ward (the viable area), you cannot walk into the operating room (the clean area) in the same clothes to perform sterile surgery. Likewise, laboratory personnel leaving the viable area must change protective garments and wash and disinfect their hands before entering the clean area.

blocks.zh: 重點提示
blocks.en: Key Points

blocks.zh: PCR 區域隔離（2022 新增）：2022 年修訂版特別新增了 DNA/RNA 樣品和 PCR 測試的隔離要求。PCR 對 DNA 汙染極度敏感 — 即使極微量的 DNA 也會被擴增產生假陽性。在 CDMO 環境中，如果你使用支原體 PCR 檢測法，PCR 操作區域必須與常規微生物實驗室完全隔離。
blocks.en: PCR area segregation (new in 2022): The 2022 revision specifically added segregation requirements for DNA/RNA samples and PCR testing. PCR is extremely sensitive to DNA contamination: even a trace amount of DNA can be amplified and produce a false positive. In a CDMO environment, if you use a PCR method for mycoplasma testing, the PCR work area must be completely segregated from the routine microbiology laboratory.

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗的環境要求：USP 明確建議無菌試驗優先使用隔離器（Isolator），因為隔離器的環境汙染水平低於有人操作的潔淨室。對 CDMO 而言，投資隔離器不僅降低假陽性風險，也在稽查時展示了對無菌保證的承諾。
blocks.en: Environmental requirements for sterility testing: USP explicitly recommends using an isolator for sterility testing, because the environmental contamination level in an isolator is lower than in a cleanroom operated by personnel. For a CDMO, investing in an isolator not only reduces the risk of false positives but also demonstrates a commitment to sterility assurance during inspections.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的實驗室空間有限，無法實現乾淨區和活菌區的完全物理隔離。你會設計哪些「替代屏障措施」來降低交叉汙染風險？
blocks.en: Your laboratory space is limited and you cannot achieve complete physical separation between the clean area and the viable area. What "alternative barrier measures" would you design to reduce the risk of cross-contamination?

blocks.zh: 一位環境監測取樣員在取完無菌製程區的培養碟後，需要將碟子送回實驗室培養。途中他必須經過活菌操作區的走廊。你認為這有風險嗎？如何改善？
blocks.en: After collecting settle plates from the sterile processing area, an environmental monitoring sampler must return the plates to the laboratory for incubation. On the way, he has to pass through the corridor of the viable work area. Do you think this is a risk? How would you improve it?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：實驗室兩區分離原則
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Two-Area Separation Principle in the Laboratory

blocks.zh: 微生物實驗室的佈局核心是將操作區域分為兩個截然不同的區域：
blocks.en: The core of a microbiology laboratory layout is to divide the work areas into two distinctly different zones:

blocks.zh: 單向流動原則：樣品一旦在乾淨區發現有生長，就「單向」移到活菌區做後續分析，不再回到乾淨區。含有生長菌落的樣品絕不應在乾淨區打開。
blocks.en: One-way flow principle: Once growth is found in a sample in the clean area, the sample moves "one way" to the viable area for further analysis and does not return to the clean area. Samples containing growing colonies must never be opened in the clean area.

blocks.zh: Sample Handling — 樣品處理
blocks.en: Sample Handling

blocks.zh: 核心概念：樣品處理的時間-溫度管控
blocks.en: Core Concept: Time and Temperature Control in Sample Handling

blocks.zh: 微生物樣品中的活菌數量會隨著時間和儲存條件而變化。延遲測試或不當儲存會導致：
blocks.en: The number of viable microorganisms in a microbiological sample changes with time and storage conditions. Delayed testing or improper storage can lead to:

blocks.zh: 菌數減少 — 某些微生物在不利條件下會死亡，導致計數偏低
blocks.en: Decreased counts - some microorganisms die under unfavorable conditions, leading to low counts

blocks.zh: 菌數增加 — 在營養豐富的樣品中，室溫保存會促進微生物繁殖
blocks.en: Increased counts - in nutrient-rich samples, storage at room temperature promotes microbial growth

blocks.zh: 菌相改變 — 不同微生物對儲存條件的耐受性不同，長時間儲存會改變菌群組成
blocks.en: Changes in microbial flora - different microorganisms tolerate storage conditions differently, so prolonged storage changes the composition of the population

blocks.zh: 標準做法：水樣和生物負載樣品在 2°–8°C 保存，24 小時內開始測試。超過 24 小時需要有挑戰試驗數據支持。
blocks.en: Standard practice: Store water and bioburden samples at 2°–8°C and begin testing within 24 hours. Storage beyond 24 hours requires supporting challenge-test data.

blocks.zh: 絕對禁止：冷凍微生物樣品 — 結凍/解凍過程會殺死部分微生物，嚴重影響計數準確性。
blocks.en: Strictly prohibited: Freezing microbiological samples. The freeze/thaw process kills some microorganisms and seriously compromises counting accuracy.

blocks.zh: 新鮮食材的比喻：微生物樣品就像新鮮食材 — 買回來的魚放在冰箱（2°–8°C）可以保存一天左右，但不能無限期放下去。放在室溫下幾小時就開始變質。而冷凍魚雖然可以長期保存，但解凍後口感和質地完全不同了（細胞結構被破壞）。同理，冷凍微生物樣品會導致細胞死亡，讓你的計數結果嚴重偏低。
blocks.en: A fresh-food analogy: Microbiological samples are like fresh ingredients. A fish bought at the market keeps for about a day in the refrigerator (2°–8°C), but not indefinitely. Left at room temperature, it starts to spoil within hours. Frozen fish can be stored for a long time, but after thawing the taste and texture are completely different (the cell structure has been damaged). Similarly, freezing a microbiological sample causes cell death and makes your counts seriously low.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 外包測試的挑戰
blocks.en: Key Points: Challenges of Outsourced Testing at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 委外實驗室的樣品運輸：2022 年修訂版特別提到了使用委外實驗室時的挑戰 — 當測試無法在 24 小時內開始時，必須有挑戰試驗數據來驗證延長保存時間的可行性。對 CDMO 而言，如果你將環境監測樣品或水樣送到外部實驗室測試，運輸過程的時間和溫度控制就變得至關重要。
blocks.en: Sample transport to contract laboratories: The 2022 revision specifically addresses the challenges of using contract laboratories: when testing cannot begin within 24 hours, challenge-test data must be available to justify the extended holding time. For a CDMO that sends environmental monitoring samples or water samples to an external laboratory, controlling the time and temperature during transport becomes critical.

blocks.zh: 樣品伴隨文件：USP 要求每個送到實驗室的樣品都應附有完整的文件記錄。這在 CDMO 環境中尤其重要 — 多條產品線、多個客戶的樣品混在一起時，完善的標識和文件系統是防止混淆的唯一保障。
blocks.en: Sample accompanying documentation: USP requires that every sample sent to the laboratory be accompanied by complete documentation. This is especially important in a CDMO environment: when samples from multiple product lines and multiple clients are handled together, a sound labeling and documentation system is the only safeguard against mix-ups.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 計畫將環境監測樣品的培養工作外包給一家距離 2 小時車程的委外實驗室。你需要建立什麼樣的驗證方案來確保運輸過程不影響測試結果？
blocks.en: Your CDMO project outsources the incubation of environmental monitoring samples to a contract laboratory a 2-hour drive away. What kind of validation program would you establish to ensure that transport does not affect the test results?

blocks.zh: 一位取樣員在週五下午 5 點取了一批水樣，但實驗室已經下班。樣品被放在冰箱（2°–8°C）直到週一早上才開始測試（約 63 小時）。這符合 USP 的建議嗎？你需要什麼數據來支持這個做法？
blocks.en: A sampler collected a batch of water samples at 5 p.m. on Friday, but the laboratory had already closed. The samples were kept in a refrigerator (2°–8°C) until testing began on Monday morning (about 63 hours later). Is this consistent with USP recommendations? What data would you need to support this practice?

blocks.zh: Incubation Temperature Excursions — 培養溫度偏移
blocks.en: Incubation Temperature Excursions

blocks.zh: 烤箱溫度偏差的比喻：如果你在烤蛋糕時烤箱溫度偏低了一點（比如設定 180°C 但實際只有 178°C），多烤幾分鐘通常就能補救。但如果溫度飆到 250°C，蛋糕表面就燒焦了，這時候延長時間沒有用 — 傷害已經造成。微生物培養也是同理：低溫偏移可以用延長時間補救，但高溫偏移可能已經殺死了部分微生物，無法逆轉。
blocks.en: An oven-temperature analogy: If your oven runs a little low while baking a cake (say it is set to 180°C but is actually at 178°C), baking a few extra minutes usually fixes it. But if the temperature spikes to 250°C, the surface of the cake burns, and extending the time does not help because the damage is done. The same is true for microbial incubation: a low-temperature excursion can be compensated for by extending the incubation time, but a high-temperature excursion may already have killed some of the microorganisms, and this cannot be reversed.

blocks.zh: TAMC vs TYMC 的溫度敏感性差異：USP 特別舉出了兩個不同的高溫閾值 — TAMC（總需氧微生物計數）的關注溫度是 >40°C，而 TYMC（總酵母菌和黴菌計數）的關注溫度是 >30°C。這是因為黴菌和酵母菌通常在 20°–25°C 培養，對高溫更加敏感。
blocks.en: Different temperature sensitivity of TAMC vs TYMC: USP gives two different high-temperature thresholds: for TAMC (total aerobic microbial count) the temperature of concern is >40°C, while for TYMC (total combined yeasts and molds count) it is >30°C. This is because molds and yeasts are usually incubated at 20°–25°C and are more sensitive to high temperatures.

blocks.zh: 文件化要求：每次溫度偏移都必須有書面調查記錄，包括偏移的持續時間、幅度、對樣品的影響評估，以及樣品的最終處置決定。這些文件在 FDA 稽查中經常被檢查。
blocks.en: Documentation requirements: Every temperature excursion must have a written investigation record, including the duration and magnitude of the excursion, an assessment of the impact on the samples, and the final disposition decision for the samples. These records are frequently reviewed during FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: 你的 30°–35°C 培養箱在週末因為壓縮機短暫故障，溫度一度升到 38°C 持續了 4 小時，然後恢復正常。箱內有正在培養中的環境監測樣品和無菌試驗樣品。你會如何分別評估這兩類樣品的影響？
blocks.en: Your 30°–35°C incubator had a brief compressor failure over the weekend, and the temperature rose to 38°C for 4 hours before returning to normal. The incubator held environmental monitoring samples and sterility test samples in progress. How would you assess the impact on each of the two types of samples?

blocks.zh: 你的實驗室使用持續溫度記錄器監控培養箱溫度。如果記錄器顯示了一次短暫的低溫偏移（降到 28°C，持續 30 分鐘），但事後校準發現記錄器本身有 ±1°C 的誤差，你需要如何處理這個情況？
blocks.en: Your laboratory monitors incubator temperature with a continuous temperature recorder. The recorder shows a brief low-temperature excursion (down to 28°C for 30 minutes), but a later calibration finds that the recorder itself has an error of ±1°C. How would you handle this situation?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：溫度偏移評估框架
blocks.en: Core Concept: Framework for Assessing Temperature Excursions

blocks.zh: 培養溫度偏移是微生物實驗室最常見的偏差類型之一。USP 提供了一個實用的評估框架：
blocks.en: Incubation temperature excursions are among the most common types of deviation in a microbiology laboratory. USP provides a practical assessment framework:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 兩區分離：實驗室分為乾淨區（處理未知樣品）和活菌區（處理已知/活菌）。含生長菌落的樣品從乾淨區單向移至活菌區
blocks.en: Two-area separation: The laboratory is divided into a clean area (handling unknown samples) and a viable area (handling known/viable organisms). Samples with growing colonies move one way from the clean area to the viable area.

blocks.zh: PCR 隔離（2022 新增）：DNA/RNA 樣品和 PCR 測試區域必須與活菌區隔離，防止 DNA 汙染
blocks.en: PCR segregation (new in 2022): DNA/RNA samples and PCR testing areas must be segregated from the viable area to prevent DNA contamination.

blocks.zh: 人員流動管控：取樣人員不應進入活菌區；進入者須穿專用防護衣、出來後洗手消毒
blocks.en: Personnel flow control: Sampling personnel should not enter the viable area; those who do must wear dedicated protective garments and wash and disinfect their hands upon leaving.

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗環境：首選隔離器（ISO 5），次選潔淨室。UDAF 適用於非關鍵測試
blocks.en: Sterility test environment: An isolator (ISO 5) is preferred, followed by a cleanroom. UDAF is suitable for non-critical testing.

blocks.zh: 樣品時間-溫度：2°–8°C 保存、24 小時內測試。絕不冷凍。超過 24 小時需挑戰試驗數據
blocks.en: Sample time and temperature: Store at 2°–8°C and test within 24 hours. Never freeze. Storage beyond 24 hours requires challenge-test data.

blocks.zh: 溫度偏移評估：低溫小幅偏移可延長培養時間補償；高溫偏移（TAMC >40°C、TYMC >30°C）需評估回收率影響
blocks.en: Temperature excursion assessment: A small low-temperature excursion can be compensated for by extending incubation; high-temperature excursions (TAMC >40°C, TYMC >30°C) require an assessment of the impact on recovery.

blocks.zh: 樣品文件：每個樣品須附來源、日期、送樣人、儲存條件等完整記錄
blocks.en: Sample documentation: Each sample must be accompanied by complete records of its source, date, submitter, storage conditions, and so on.
